name: ai_content_studio_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the ai_content_studio capability.

prompts.name: script_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Write a comprehensive and engaging YouTube video script about {topic} in a {tone} tone.
prompts.use_case: YouTubers seeking to automate repetitive content production

prompts.name: voiceover_generation_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a clear and natural voiceover audio reading the following script: {script}
prompts.use_case: Content creators needing hands-free video generation at scale

prompts.name: video_description_prompt
prompts.template: Create a video description for a YouTube video about {topic} to maximize viewer engagement.
prompts.use_case: Marketing teams automating video ads or promotional content
